## Creating `vec.num`
```{r}
vec.num <- c(5, 2, 15, -1, 0)
vec.num
```
## Creating `vec.logic`
```{r}
vec.logic <- c(TRUE,FALSE,TRUE)
vec.logic
```
## Creating `vec.4`
```{r}
vec.4 <- seq(from = 4, to = 28, by = 4)
vec.4
```
## Creating `vec.1000`
```{r}
vec.1000 <- seq(from = 0, to = 1, length = 1000)
head(vec.1000) #show first 6 values
tail(vec.1000) #show last 6 values
```
## Creating `Vec_num`
```{r}
Vec_num <- 1:20
Vec_num
```
## Creating `vec_friends`
```{r}
vec_friends <- c("Kayla","Cierra","Maleena")
vec_friends
```
## Creating `vec_repeat1`
```{r}
vec_repeat1 <- rep(vec_friends, times = 3)
vec_repeat1
```
## Creating `vec_repeat2`
```{r}
vec_repeat2 <- rep(vec_friends, each = 3)
vec_repeat2
```
